messages:
Marta (product): Quick announcement: we're switching the GitHub <-> Jira sync to app-based auth and JWT verification. Old PATs used by the sync will be retired on 2026-08-01. Please review the migration plan: https://intranet.redwood/github-jira-app-migration :mega:
Diego (eng): Got it. Does this affect repo-level webhooks and the commit-to-ticket automation?
Marta (product): Yes 100%. Webhooks will now include an HMAC signature header (x-rdwh-signature) and the sync worker will validate a signed JWT from the GitHub App. You should stop storing PATs in repo secrets for the sync.
Aisha (devex): We'll add a new step to the CI templates to validate the webhook payload in integration tests. Snippet in the guide uses the local verifier action.
Diego (eng): Example of the new webhook header check?
Aisha (devex): Example (node):
```js
const sig = req.headers['x-rdwh-signature'];
if(!verifyHmac(sig, process.env.WEBHOOK_SECRET, req.rawBody)) {
  return res.status(401).end();
}
```
Alex (security): Migration checklist: rotate any PATs used by jira-sync, remove PAT scopes from repo secrets, install the GitHub App (redwood-jira-sync) at org level, and audit app permissions. We'll run a permissions review next week.
jira-sync-bot: Reminder: scheduled sync job "jira-issue-sync" will switch to app auth on 2026-07-25 in test mode.
Marta (product): Timeline: 2026-06-15 -> test mode for selected repos, 2026-07-25 -> org-wide test mode, 2026-08-01 -> enforce and retire old PATs. Test mode will accept both auth methods for 7 days.
Diego (eng): How do we opt a repo into test mode?
Aisha (devex): Add the repo label `jira-sync:app-test` or set the org flag via the infra console. Docs: https://intranet.redwood/github-jira-app-migration#opt-in . We'll also publish a migration-lane that auto-creates PRs to update webhook verification and remove PAT references.
Alex (security): Emergency rollback plan: if the app causes failures, we can re-enable PAT acceptance for specific repos for up to 72 hours via a support ticket + 2-person approval. Full runbook linked in the docs.
webhook-bot: New release deployed: redwood/jira-verifier v1.3.0 @ 2026-05-04T09:03:12Z :rocket:
Diego (eng): Will this change how CI parses jira keys from commits? Our monorepo tooling extracts issue keys using git hooks.
Aisha (devex): No change to parsing. Only the sync/storage layer uses the new auth. Your hookups remain the same. We'll add a quick CI test to make sure the verifier passes for sample payloads.
Marta (product): We'll publish the full list of affected repos by EOD Friday and open a migration channel #gh-jira-migration. Please escalate any blockers there. :handshake:
Diego (eng): Thanks, we'll schedule time this week to update templates and run the tests.
Marta (product): Appreciate it. If you run into permission errors, ping Alex and include the failing webhook payload and timestamps.
